nodes.label: Decisions Log
nodes.rationale: Native Kilo integration was chosen over graphify opencode install because Kilo is the acting agent; extraction ran via a subagent because the Gemini backend lacked its SDK.

nodes.label: Graphify Query-First Protocol
nodes.rationale: Query graph.json before grep or source reads to get a scoped subgraph and cut context cost.

nodes.label: TDD Discipline
nodes.rationale: Fail test first, then implement, then refactor; no phase is done until tests pass.

nodes.label: Agent Workflow Rules
nodes.rationale: One phase at a time in PROGRESS order with small semantic commits avoids scope creep and keeps each phase ending with passing tests.

nodes.label: Bulkhead Semaphores
nodes.rationale: Separate semaphores for DB reads, DB writes, argon2 hashing and DNS stop one slow dependency from exhausting all workers.

nodes.label: Token Bucket Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: One atomic Lua script avoids races; on Redis failure a circuit breaker falls back to an in-process bucket so degradation never means unlimited traffic.

nodes.label: Anti Cache Stampede Three Layers
nodes.rationale: SWR jitter and single-flight together stop an expired popular code from stampeding PostgreSQL; negative caching blocks scans of unknown codes.

nodes.label: Honesty in Reporting
nodes.rationale: Only claim validated what was executed; unverified work goes to PROGRESS Nao validado instead of inventing results.

nodes.label: Next.js Locale Routing and Rewrites
nodes.rationale: Short links live at the root, so rewrites fallback forwards /:code to the API while the next-intl matcher excludes those paths; the browser only talks to the frontend domain.

nodes.label: Navbar
nodes.rationale: The owner AImaginator Navbar.tsx attachment overrides the written spec in P05; Galeria is removed and Estudio becomes Links.

nodes.label: JWT and Rotating Refresh Sessions
nodes.rationale: 15-minute access JWT plus rotating refresh tokens with reuse detection limit the blast radius of theft; cookies are httpOnly Secure SameSite and never localStorage.

nodes.label: Row Level Security
nodes.rationale: Policies keyed on app.current_user_id add defense in depth against IDOR beyond application-level ownership checks.

nodes.label: States and Quality Targets
nodes.rationale: Loading empty error and offline states, 320px to 1440px responsiveness, no layout shift and Lighthouse 95+ set the quality bar.

nodes.label: Code Standards
nodes.rationale: Dependencies point inward, strict typing with no any, parameterized SQL, and every endpoint needs bounded schemas, rate limiting, authorization and a negative-access test.

nodes.label: click_events Table
nodes.rationale: IP is never stored for privacy/LGPD; country comes only from edge headers, with no external lookup.

nodes.label: Redis Stream Click Buffer
nodes.rationale: Redirect never waits for an INSERT; a flusher batches events, and Redis downtime drops events with a metric so redirects continue.

nodes.label: Tricolink URL Shortener Product
nodes.rationale: Portfolio project focused on backend engineering security and polished UI; medium-scope Bitly-like interface excludes QR Pages UTM custom domains AI and paid plans, and uses EC Bahia colors without the club crest.

nodes.label: SSRF Prevention
nodes.rationale: The server never fetches user URLs, so SSRF surface stays minimal; changing that requires a security review.

nodes.label: Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Blue is primary, red is reserved for the main CTA and errors, white dominates backgrounds; AA contrast plus a subtle tricolor stripe carry the brand without the club crest.

nodes.label: 302 Redirect Decision
nodes.rationale: 302 instead of 301 prevents browser caching so every access reaches the server and can be counted.

nodes.label: CONTEXT.md Supremacy Rule
nodes.rationale: Never implement against CONTEXT.md; log spec ambiguity in PROGRESS Bloqueios and take the safest simplest option.

nodes.label: Decided Technology Stack
nodes.rationale: Stack is fixed and must not be swapped; secrets only via os.getenv in core/config.py.

nodes.label: Spec Outranks Graph Rule
nodes.rationale: When the graph diverges from CONTEXT.md the spec wins; fix the code or log the divergence in PROGRESS Bloqueios.

nodes.label: Prohibited Actions
nodes.rationale: No destructive commands outside the project, no git push, no hard reset, no unnecessary dependencies, and no stack or API change without updating CONTEXT.md.

nodes.label: 7-Char Base62 Code Generation
nodes.rationale: Codes use secrets never random; UNIQUE plus up to five retries on IntegrityError resolves collisions.

nodes.label: refresh_tokens Table
nodes.rationale: Stores only SHA-256 hashes with a family_id so rotation and reuse detection can revoke an entire token family.
